body:
MAINLINE-018 checked independently. All four held-geometry rescores and their modes reproduce: optimistic Be 0.685338231171, K13D2U 0.651932173894, AlBeMet 0.553994420508, SiC 0.235167984044; conservative 0.137067646234, 0.130450400320, 0.110868173353, 0.235159313250.

I downloaded CR-1457 from NTRS and visually read pages 6-7 and 6-12. Unity at Vc >= 2 is the handbook rule; its continuous transition is unspecified.

One demonstrated correction affects three Sim dimple fields: the unequal-face factor is 0.999702513752156, giving sigma0 19113852932.30557 Pa, Vc 197.18758027094242 and Gc(Vc=2) 1971875802.7094243 Pa. Filed Vc was 197.24625832023136. Flat Vc 201.532463528414 reproduces. Both remain on the crimp branch.

The 0.20/0.22 numerical KDFs use perfect linear FE pressures. Their imperfect pressures exceed the conditional handbook unity-crimp predictions by 1.4464/1.5400, so those KDFs alone do not refute unity. Physical validation and the missing source/test series remain NFI. 130 numeric comparisons: 127 match; three share the unequal-face correction. QUESTIONABLE/PROJECTION; no certification.

Proceeding to MAINLINE-009d both points. This report does not close the two-part order.
